title: 科技与互联网
desc: 覆盖互联网普及、人工智能、网络社交、隐私隐患与数字鸿沟的图画作文高频表达

entries.zh: 前所未有的；史无前例的
entries.example: The past two decades have witnessed unprecedented changes in the way people communicate and work.
entries.exampleZh: 过去二十年见证了人们交流和工作方式前所未有的变化。
entries.note: 常修饰 change/scale/speed；适合开头段。

entries.zh: 无处不在的；无所不在的
entries.example: Smartphones have become so omnipresent that a single day without them seems unimaginable to urban dwellers.
entries.exampleZh: 智能手机已无处不在，以至于对都市人来说，没有它们的一天简直不可想象。
entries.note: 程度强于 common，只用于描述普遍现象，开头段用。

entries.zh: 无处不在的；普遍存在的
entries.example: Mobile payment is now ubiquitous in Chinese cities, from street stalls to luxury shopping malls.
entries.exampleZh: 移动支付如今在中国城市无处不在，从路边摊到奢侈品商场。
entries.note: 常作表语或定语；比 widespread 更书面，勿拼错。

entries.example: The Internet has permeated every corner of daily life, reshaping how we shop, learn and socialize.
entries.exampleZh: 互联网已渗透到日常生活的每个角落，重塑了我们购物、学习和社交的方式。
entries.note: 及物动词，直接接宾语；常搭配 every corner。

entries.example: Artificial intelligence is transforming the workplace at a pace that few workers are prepared for.
entries.exampleZh: 人工智能正以少有劳动者准备好应对的速度改变着职场。
entries.note: 常缩写为 AI；作主语时谓语用单数。

entries.example: Recommendation algorithms decide what we read and buy, quietly shaping our preferences and choices.
entries.exampleZh: 推荐算法决定我们读什么、买什么，悄然塑造着我们的偏好与选择。
entries.note: 可数名词，泛指用复数；常搭配 recommendation。

entries.example: Big data enables companies to predict consumer behavior accurately, yet it also raises privacy concerns.
entries.exampleZh: 大数据使企业能准确预测消费者行为，但也引发了隐私担忧。
entries.note: 不可数，谓语用单数；主体段可用 yet also 转折。

entries.example: Rising automation has displaced millions of routine jobs, forcing workers to acquire new skills.
entries.exampleZh: 日益提高的自动化取代了数百万常规工作，迫使劳动者掌握新技能。
entries.note: 不可数名词；常搭配 displace jobs，谈就业话题。

entries.example: China has invested heavily in cutting-edge technologies such as 5G, quantum computing and new energy.
entries.exampleZh: 中国在5G、量子计算和新能源等尖端技术上投入巨大。
entries.note: 连字符不可省；常修饰 technology，比 advanced 好。

entries.example: The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art devices that help doctors diagnose diseases far earlier.
entries.exampleZh: 这家医院配备了最先进的设备，帮助医生更早地诊断疾病。
entries.note: 多作定语，常修饰 equipment；与 cutting-edge 同义。

entries.example: Rules and ethics in cyberspace should be established as firmly as those in the physical world.
entries.exampleZh: 网络空间中的规则与伦理应像现实世界一样被牢固地建立起来。
entries.note: 不可数，通常加 the；谈网络治理时用。

entries.example: Spending hours on social media may alienate us from family members sitting in the same room.
entries.exampleZh: 花数小时刷社交媒体可能使我们与同处一室的家人疏远。
entries.note: 常用 alienate sb from sb；比 avoid 高级。

entries.example: An excessive reliance on online contact can isolate young people from real social life.
entries.exampleZh: 过度依赖线上联系会使年轻人与现实社交生活隔离。
entries.note: 及物动词，搭配 isolate sb from sth。

entries.example: Misinformation spreads faster online than facts, which is why media literacy matters so much today.
entries.exampleZh: 错误信息在网上的传播快于事实，这正是当今媒介素养如此重要的原因。
entries.note: 不可数，指错误信息；故意造谣用 disinformation。

entries.example: Cyberbullying can inflict lasting psychological damage on teenagers who dare not speak out.
entries.exampleZh: 网络欺凌会给不敢开口的青少年造成持久的心理伤害。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 suffer from、combat 搭配。

entries.example: Online fraud has grown increasingly sophisticated, targeting the elderly who know little about digital security.
entries.exampleZh: 网络诈骗日益精密，专门针对对数字安全知之甚少的老年人。
entries.note: 不可数，网诈说 online fraud，不用复数。

entries.example: Smartphone addiction is quietly eroding students' concentration and sleep quality.
entries.exampleZh: 手机成瘾正在悄然侵蚀学生的专注力和睡眠质量。
entries.note: 常搭配 addiction to sth，如 to social media。

entries.example: Governments should improve the accessibility of public digital services for the elderly and the disabled.
entries.exampleZh: 政府应提高面向老年人和残疾人的公共数字服务的可及性。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 improve 搭配，谈数字鸿沟时用。

entries.example: Online platforms have streamlined procedures that once required long queues and endless paperwork.
entries.exampleZh: 网络平台精简了曾经需要排长队和填无数表格的流程。
entries.note: 及物动词，宾语多为 process；核心义是提效。

entries.example: Video conferencing has greatly facilitated cross-border cooperation between companies and researchers.
entries.exampleZh: 视频会议大大促进了公司和研究人员之间的跨国合作。
entries.note: 及物动词，后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

entries.example: Only by harnessing technology wisely can we turn its potential into benefits for everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 只有明智地利用技术，我们才能把它的潜力转化为惠及所有人的利益。
entries.note: 及物动词，常接 technology；比 use 高级。

entries.example: Judicious use of digital devices can boost productivity rather than undermine it.
entries.exampleZh: 明智地使用数字设备能提高而非削弱生产力。
entries.note: 多作定语，常修饰 use；副词 judiciously。

entries.zh: 低头族；只顾看手机的人
entries.example: Phubbers stare at their screens at dinner tables, ignoring the people sitting right beside them.
entries.exampleZh: 低头族在餐桌上盯着屏幕，无视就坐在身旁的人。
entries.note: 由 phone 与 snub 合成，带贬义，描写图画好用。

entries.example: Many young people now take a weekend digital detox to regain control of their own time.
entries.exampleZh: 如今许多年轻人选择周末数字排毒，以重新掌控自己的时间。
entries.note: 可数名词；常与 take 搭配，结尾段提建议用。

entries.zh: 盯着屏幕不放；屏幕不离眼
entries.example: Teenagers today are glued to their screens for hours, seldom talking with their parents.
entries.exampleZh: 如今的青少年一连数小时盯着屏幕，很少与父母交谈。
entries.note: 固定搭配，强调沉迷；也可作状语修饰主语。

entries.en: with one's head buried in a phone
entries.zh: 埋头看手机；低头刷手机
entries.example: Walk down any street and you will see pedestrians with their heads buried in phones.
entries.exampleZh: 走在任何一条街上，你都会看到低头盯着手机的行人。
entries.note: with 复合结构作伴随状语，描写画面感强。

entries.example: Doctors advise limiting children's daily screen time to less than two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议把儿童每天的屏幕使用时间限制在两小时以内。
entries.note: 不可数；与 limit、reduce 搭配，健康话题常用。

entries.example: Online forums have formed virtual communities where strangers with shared interests support each other.
entries.exampleZh: 网络论坛形成了虚拟社区，兴趣相投的陌生人在这里互相支持。
entries.note: 可数名词；常与 form、join 搭配。

entries.example: Social networking sites have redefined friendship, turning distant acquaintances into daily contacts.
entries.exampleZh: 社交网站重新定义了友谊，把远方的泛泛之交变成日常联系的对象。
entries.note: 常作定语修饰 site、app；不可数，勿加 s。

entries.example: Nothing can fully replace face-to-face interaction, in which tone and gesture carry real meaning.
entries.exampleZh: 没有什么能完全取代面对面交流，因为语气与手势在其中传递真实含义。
entries.note: 不可数；与 replace 搭配，论证线上社交不足。

entries.example: Excessive online chatting may erode teenagers' interpersonal communication skills in real settings.
entries.exampleZh: 过度网络聊天可能削弱青少年在真实场景中的人际沟通能力。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 skills 连用，注意拼写。

entries.example: A single privacy leakage can expose millions of users' personal data to malicious hands.
entries.exampleZh: 一次隐私泄露就可能把数百万用户的个人数据暴露给恶意者。
entries.note: 常与 cause、risk 搭配；也作 data leakage。

entries.example: The digital divide between urban and rural areas may further widen the gap in educational resources.
entries.exampleZh: 城乡之间的数字鸿沟可能会进一步拉大教育资源差距。
entries.note: 可数，常加 the；与 narrow、bridge 搭配。

entries.example: Smartphones give us instant access to information that once took days to find.
entries.exampleZh: 智能手机让我们即时获取曾经需要数天才能找到的信息。
entries.note: give sb instant access to sth，to 为介词。

entries.example: With a single tap, a world of knowledge and services lies at our fingertips.
entries.exampleZh: 轻点一下，一个知识与服务的世界便尽在我们的指尖。
entries.note: 以物作主语，介词只用 at，勿用 in。

entries.example: Artificial intelligence is a double-edged sword, offering efficiency while threatening millions of jobs.
entries.exampleZh: 人工智能是一把双刃剑，带来效率的同时威胁着数百万个工作岗位。
entries.note: 常作表语；同义 cut both ways，用于转折处。

entries.en: be a blessing or a curse
entries.example: Whether the Internet is a blessing or a curse depends entirely on how we use it.
entries.exampleZh: 互联网是福是祸，完全取决于我们如何使用它。
entries.note: 常作表语，与 whether 从句搭配，表辩证观点。

entries.en: weigh the benefits against the drawbacks
entries.example: Before embracing any new technology, we should weigh its benefits against its potential drawbacks.
entries.exampleZh: 在拥抱任何新技术之前，我们都应权衡其益处与潜在弊端。
entries.note: 动词短语，its 与主语一致，替代 good and bad。

entries.example: Students should make judicious use of digital tools instead of surrendering to them.
entries.exampleZh: 学生应明智地使用数字工具，而不是向它们屈服。
entries.note: 后接名词；可替换 use properly，结尾段加分。

entries.example: Only by striking a balance between online convenience and offline life can we stay healthy.
entries.exampleZh: 只有在线上便利与线下生活之间取得平衡，我们才能保持健康。
entries.note: 结构为 between A and B，结尾段提方案用。

entries.example: If put to good use, technology can narrow rather than widen social gaps.
entries.exampleZh: 如果善加利用，技术能缩小而非拉大社会差距。
entries.note: 固定搭配 put sth to good use，可作条件状语。

entries.example: Modern students are overly dependent on search engines, losing the habit of independent thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 现代学生过度依赖搜索引擎，正在丧失独立思考的习惯。
entries.note: overly 比 too 书面；同义 be addicted to。

entries.en: The Internet has permeated every facet of life, from ___ to ___.
entries.zh: 互联网已渗透到生活的方方面面，从…到…。
entries.example: The Internet has permeated every facet of life, from the way we work to the way we relax.
entries.exampleZh: 互联网已渗透到生活的方方面面，从我们的工作方式到休闲方式。
entries.note: 万能开头句；facet 可换 aspect，末尾并列收尾。

entries.en: While ___ has brought unprecedented convenience, it has also ___.
entries.zh: 尽管…带来了前所未有的便利，它同时也…。
entries.example: While digital technology has brought unprecedented convenience, it has also eroded our privacy.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管数字技术带来了前所未有的便利，它同时也侵蚀了我们的隐私。
entries.note: 让步转折句式，放主体段首句，末尾接贬义词。

entries.example: Never before have we enjoyed such easy access to information in human history.
entries.exampleZh: 人类历史上，我们从未像今天这样便捷地获取信息。
entries.note: 部分倒装，助动词提前；空处填过去分词。

entries.en: It is not technology itself but the way we use it that ___.
entries.zh: 决定…的不是技术本身，而是我们使用它的方式。
entries.example: It is not technology itself but the way we use it that determines its true value.
entries.exampleZh: 决定技术真正价值的不是技术本身，而是我们使用它的方式。
entries.note: 强调句型；that 后谓语用单数，结尾段升华。

entries.example: So pervasive is mobile payment that many young people no longer carry cash.
entries.exampleZh: 移动支付如此普遍，以至于许多年轻人不再带现金。
entries.note: so 提前引起倒装，比 very common 高级。

entries.example: Only by using technology with restraint can we enjoy its benefits without being enslaved.
entries.exampleZh: 只有克制地使用技术，我们才能享受其益处而不被其奴役。
entries.note: only 状语置句首时主句倒装；by 后接动名词。

entries.example: What matters is not how advanced the tool is but how wisely we employ it.
entries.exampleZh: 重要的不是工具有多先进，而是我们使用它有多明智。
entries.note: what 引导主语从句，谓语用单数，替代 I think。

entries.zh: 技术若得到合理利用，能够…。
entries.example: Technology, if properly harnessed, can liberate us from repetitive chores and free our creativity.
entries.exampleZh: 技术若得到合理利用，能把我们从重复性杂务中解放出来，释放我们的创造力。
entries.note: 插入语结构，if 后省略 it is，论证价值用。

entries.en: With the rapid advancement of ___, ___ has become increasingly common.
entries.zh: 随着…的迅速发展，…已变得越来越普遍。
entries.example: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, remote working has become increasingly common.
entries.exampleZh: 随着人工智能的迅速发展，远程办公已变得越来越普遍。
entries.note: 描述趋势的开头模板，谓语用现在完成时。

entries.en: ___ is a double-edged sword: it ___ while ___.
entries.example: Social media is a double-edged sword: it connects the world while isolating individuals.
entries.exampleZh: 社交媒体是一把双刃剑：它连接世界，同时又孤立个人。
entries.note: 冒号后并列两分句，while 表对比。

entries.en: "Technology is a useful servant but a dangerous master." — Christian Lous Lange
entries.zh: “技术是有用的仆人，却是危险的主人。”——克里斯蒂安·劳斯·兰格
entries.example: "Technology is a useful servant but a dangerous master," a warning that rings truer than ever today.
entries.exampleZh: “技术是有用的仆人，却是危险的主人”，这一警告在今天比以往任何时候都更真切。
entries.note: 谈科技利弊与合理使用；作结尾段首句。

entries.en: "Our technology has exceeded our humanity." — Albert Einstein
entries.zh: “我们的技术已超越了我们的人性。”——阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
entries.example: As Einstein warned, our technology has exceeded our humanity, so our wisdom must catch up.
entries.exampleZh: 正如爱因斯坦所警告的，我们的技术已超越了我们的人性，因此我们的智慧必须跟上。
entries.note: 谈科技伦理与网络隐患；引用后须自己论述。

entries.en: "The real problem is not whether machines think but whether men do." — B. F. Skinner
entries.zh: “真正的问题不在于机器是否会思考，而在于人是否会思考。”——B.F. 斯金纳
entries.example: Skinner once observed that the real problem is not whether machines think but whether men do.
entries.exampleZh: 斯金纳曾指出，真正的问题不在于机器是否会思考，而在于人是否会思考。
entries.note: 谈 AI 取代人类与独立思考，结尾段引用。
